configuration.summaryZh: Android 发包配置检查未通过，请使用 CI 正式构建，或修正构建环境后重试。
configuration.summaryEn: Android distribution configuration checks failed. Use the CI release build, or fix the build environment and retry.

artifact.summaryZh: Android 安装包的反馈配置校验未通过，请重新构建后重试。
artifact.summaryEn: The Android package failed feedback configuration validation. Rebuild and retry.

preparation.summaryZh: Android 发布准备未通过，请检查源码、发布说明和开发验证后重试。
preparation.summaryEn: Android release preparation failed. Check the source, release notes and development checks, then retry.
